LAYOUT-2: the jit fall at LEVER-13 is a placement draw (cause DRAW); G2 REPEAT
LEVER-13 alone, information cells: default form jit 1.034 slower, jitless 0.983; aligned form both intervals hold 1.000
LDAR-ELIDE arm 2 MERGE: jitless TS x1.043 in a same-binary A/B, 2-5 times the plan-v16 Ir record and above the time-only ceiling x1.024
LDAR-ELIDE x64 TS Ir: jit -2.926%, jitless -2.961% (591064fc -> 0814321a)
X86-ALIGN-RULE MERGE: jit x1.043 at T_end, jitless x0.999, spread across 3 trees 0.0091

findings.claim: TD-2 at m10-p5: ep9 jitless 26.272 G cycles against node 24.976 G at 4.7% fewer instructions; CPI +10.4%
TD-2 buckets: named load at parity (+0.003 G); Ldar +0.790 G; Wide +0.646 G (+0.349 like for like); Star + Mov +0.761 G
The named load costs the same cycles per run as V8 with no Star (22.42 against 22.41); ep9 is backend-bound there, node frontend-bound
All-thread cycles at m11-p3 are about node's (24.86 G against 24.98 G), but node runs 2.35% more CPU per wall second: the rest of the wall gap is not in the loop buckets that month 11 attacked
The named month-12 candidates give x1.022 in A/B terms (x1.007-1.050); x1.018 at the Path B with a 0.8 transfer, x1.013 with 0.6; short of the need in the center case
The front-end stack budget is a worst-case byte budget proved only on the FORMS set: WORKER = 2 MiB + 1.5 x max(25,000 x PPU, 20,000 x PPL), under a 256 MiB assert
8 forms outside FORMS use up to 9,216 B per pre-scan unit in debug at oxc 0.159.0 (budget 6,199); 2 of them were already over at 0.158.0 (6,384, 6,288); release stays inside
At the pre-scan cap the measured debug parse stack is 159.6 MB (0.158.0) and 230.4 MB (0.159.0) of 232.5 MB: margin 1.46x and 1.009x; a clean RangeError, no abort, on aarch64 only

3 check rounds and a 4-target side CI passed at 0.159.0 because they measured FORMS only and tested no-abort, not the margin; a second-model review that added 8 long-list forms found it; one verifier confirmed it
findings.rule: a check of a measured budget must add inputs outside the measured set

findings.claim: V8, JSC, SpiderMonkey and QuickJS compare the real stack pointer with a limit at each parser recursion step and return a normal error; oxc has no such check
Options (a)-(f) for the debug stack; R17M recommends (a'): a measured debug PPU and a debug-only 512 MiB ceiling, with the missing FORMS, in DEPS-BUMP-3; the decision is a plan row
Month-11 boxes: 12.20 box-h before the end read (lever A/B 66%, cause reads 16%, Path B 17%, fuzz 0); 13.95 of 15.9 after it
A/B form resolution: 1-box A/A widths 0.0227-0.0300; 62 pairs 0.0147-0.0169; 93 pairs 0.0089; the 0.988 cycles line alone caused the one more box (0.9890)

Checks that changed an outcome: the code-slice review, box-script and pre-registration checks, one verifier of a reviewer claim. Checks that did not: 3 tag CIs, the second records reviewer, about 9 DL fact checks, the 3 DEPS check rounds
Records load: 121 DL rows, 336,428 characters; records 12.68 M of 41.52 M tokens (31%) against engine work 5.76 M (14%); tokens per 1% of jitless time about 7.5 M (month 10: 24 M)

R22 hypotheses after month 11: the jit fall is layout (confirmed); the +32 B box offset (not supported: e-jit 48, e-jitless 16); x64 decode cost (refuted by K2); the 4-load chain (not supported at the bucket level); dead S> Ldar elision gives time (confirmed)
